parsed_output.target_core_mechanism: Personalized meal suggestion engine that uses user-provided pantry inventory and estimated expiration dates to generate recipes for one- or two-person meals.
feasibility_notes: User-provided inventory is feasible via manual entry but may introduce friction; UI design must be simple for single‑person households
Recipe generation based on limited ingredient sets is technically straightforward using existing recommendation algorithms
Estimating expiration dates relies on user honesty; no automated verification is required for the core
Scalable backend can be built with standard cloud services; no special hardware needed
reality_dependencies: Accurate self‑reported pantry items and expiration dates from participants
A curated recipe database that can be filtered by ingredient availability and serving size
A method to quantify individual food waste (e.g., waste logs, weight measurements)
Recruitment of a representative sample of one‑ to two‑person cooks
Ethical approval and consent for data collection
claims_needing_evidence: Personalized suggestions based on pantry data lead to a measurable reduction in food waste
Users will regularly consult and follow the suggested recipes
Self‑reported inventory data is sufficiently accurate to drive effective recommendations
potential_blockers: Low user compliance in entering pantry data and expiration dates
Inaccurate or outdated inventory information reducing suggestion relevance
Difficulty in reliably measuring actual food waste at the household level
Potential privacy concerns about sharing pantry contents
candidate_tests: Run a randomized controlled trial: group A uses the personalized suggestion engine, group B receives generic recipes; compare food waste over 4 weeks
Conduct a usability study where participants log pantry items and rate suggestion relevance; track adherence rates
Measure waste reduction by weighing discarded food before and after intervention in a within‑subject design
exploratory_candidate_tests: Test AI‑driven visual pantry scanner prototype to assess extraction accuracy of ingredients and dates
Evaluate gamified badge system on user engagement and waste reporting frequency
Pilot integration with RFID‑enabled containers to auto‑sync inventory and compare impact on suggestion effectiveness
